name: Eli Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning

reviews.text: We’ve had David cleaning the carpets in our two rental properties here in Philadelphia for a while now, and we honestly wouldn’t trust anyone else with the job. His prices are very fair, and you can tell he really cares about making carpets look their best. Since our rentals are short-term and sometimes guests aren’t too careful, we often end up with all sorts of stains or spills. But whenever that happens, I just give David a call and he always shows up quickly, ready to work his magic. Every time, he manages to make our carpets look fresh and spotless again. As someone who loves supporting local businesses, I can say you’re in good hands choosing David for carpet and upholstery cleaning. He treats our homes like they’re his own. The last time, we had a tenant move out after a long stay, and David brought the carpets back to life—they looked fantastic. He also did an amazing job cleaning the upholstery and the floors in our Airbnb after a guest left things pretty messy. You’d never know how dirty it was before. If you need a reliable and thorough carpet cleaning service in Philadelphia, just call David. You won’t be disappointed!
reviews.author: Derek W

reviews.text: i always check reviews before hiring a company for carpet cleaning. eli carpet & upholstery cleaning had excellent feedback, so i decided to give them a try. david and his co-worker arrived right on time and did an amazing job. they worked carefully and cleaned some tough stains from one area of my carpet, making it look so much better. david even showed me that there were some metal shavings under my reclining sofa, which i didn't know about. since the sofa is really heavy, he put sliders underneath so it would be much easier to move next time. i really appreciated that extra help. they also refreshed one of our recliners and made it look great. after finishing, they gave us disposable slippers so we could walk on the freshly cleaned carpet while it was still drying. honestly, they did a much better job than the coupon cleaner i used before. david's number is definitely saved for future carpet cleaning appointments.
reviews.author: T Glenn

reviews.text: Eli Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning did a fantastic job cleaning the carpet in our one-bedroom apartment. After calling around for quotes, they gave us the best price by far. Grant was able to offer us quick service, with availability as soon as the next day. He showed up right on time and was both friendly and professional throughout the process. We’ve had our carpet cleaned several times before, but Grant managed to get out stains that other cleaners said would never come out. The whole job was done really well and at a great value. If I could give more than five stars, I definitely would!
reviews.author: Ava Acosta

reviews.text: If you need someone to clean your carpets and area rugs in Philadelphia, I highly recommend Eli Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning. Tanner took extra care with my carpets, giving them a deep clean that brought back their original color and softness. He also did an amazing job refreshing a few area rugs I thought were beyond saving. The attention to detail was impressive—he made sure everything was spotless and even tackled some tricky spots on my upholstery. Very reliable and professional service. I've already told friends and family about this company because it's hard to find someone who takes such pride in their work. My carpets and furniture look fantastic!
reviews.author: Giovanni M

reviews.text: When we were preparing to sell our home, our realtor suggested using Eli Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning for the carpets. Grant was very accommodating with our tight schedule and made the whole process simple and stress-free. They arrived exactly when promised and stuck to the original price, which was very fair for the quality of work. Our carpets looked fresh and spotless after they finished. A few weeks later, we accidentally got a tough stain on our light-colored bedroom rug right before an important showing. Even though they had a busy schedule, Grant personally came by our house the same day and brought us a special cleaner just for that stain. It was amazing customer service—going the extra mile to help us out at the last minute. You really don’t see that kind of dedication very often!
reviews.author: Kerri Molina
